meta.title: Leonida Legend — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Tracker
notes: All 55 trophies are offline single-player. There are no online trophies.
Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep cheats off for a trophy run.
There is no mission replay and no New Game+, but free roam continues after the story, so almost everything can be finished after the credits.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots + 1 autosave).
Chapter trophies pop late: they usually unlock after the first mission of the next chapter, not at the chapter-end cutscene.
The name of trophy 12 is shown in full in displayName; its JSON name uses the asterisked spelling the gate matches.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
Insider Gaming — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List
Push Square — GTA 6 PS5 Trophies Revealed

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: There is nothing extra to do for this one: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. It usually pops right after A Long Road or whichever cleanup trophy you finish last. No online play, DLC or difficulty setting is attached to it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The 100% checklist only appears after the story, at Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — but anything you did during the story already counts toward it. It is forgiving: most lines ask for only part of a total (200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 15 of 18 meditations). Only a few lines demand everything: all robberies, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all underwater discoveries, every shooting-range gold medal, all drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. Budget roughly 100 of the ~200 total hours for this trophy alone.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the story: this pops for completing the last story mission, the Chapter 5 finale. Note: a few outlets word the description as “Complete Chapter 5” instead — same unlock, different wording. Ignore any guide note tying this trophy to Chapter 4; that is a copy-paste error in one guide. No mission replay exists, but no trophy depends on how a mission is played, so just play the story through.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.targetNote: 250 of 397 stunts; the 100% checklist later wants 300
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the game's 397 stunts count, in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base-jump parachute challenges. Flying under bridges is the fastest way to rack up numbers. The optional challenge shown on each stunt icon is not required — performing the stunt once counts. Track progress at Progress, Activities, Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 challenges across the 12 shooting ranges. Ranges stay open after the story, so treat this as a post-story grind alongside the 100% checklist, which also demands every range gold. Range practice also raises the Focus stat, which helps with Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Vault robberies unlock through the Chapter 4 optional mission “That's Where The Money Is…”: tail a security van to a bank and slip in while the vault is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so bring your partner and hand over a bag. Every vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast bike, then swap vehicles to break recognition. Each vault can pay up to $205,000. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, so this pops on the way there; Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only certain questlines count toward this one: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed counters. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count, even though they have their own trophies. Which other strands count was still being confirmed when this guide was written, so watch the trophy's own progress counter in the PS5 trophy list. None of these strands are needed for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Pick any 3 of the 18 card sets and finish them; there is no need to complete all of them. Progress per set is shown in the Collections section of the Progress menu. Cards are a natural pick-up-while-exploring collectible — fold them into map-unfogging runs.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: “WAiNK It” means scanning with the WAiNK phone app: hold Up on the D-pad, then R1, and scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags. Any 100 scans count, and the 100% checklist also wants 100 WAiNK scans, so this pops during that grind. Scanning is also how vehicles are discovered, so it progresses together with Whip It Good.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: it pops after the opening mission, Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1. Nothing to prepare — just play the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Awarded for story progress. It pops after playing the first mission of Chapter 2 (“What's in the Bag?”), not at the Chapter 1 end cutscene — a delayed pop is normal. While you are still in Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude) before moving on.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Awarded for story progress. It pops as Chapter 3 begins, after the “Welcome to Vice City” mission. Most outlets censor the name with asterisks; the full spelling is shown here. After Chapter 2's “Coffee Break” mission, Jason and Lucia can be played together — that unlocks the partner trophies Hot Together and Retail Therapy.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Awarded for story progress. It pops after the first two Chapter 4 missions (“Ocean Beach” and “Another Life”). Chapter 3 is where several systems unlock (Key Cloner, Yasmani's jewelry jobs, Andy's questline) — a good moment to start side content.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Awarded for story progress. It pops after the final Chapter 4 main mission (“Starting From Zero”). Chapter 4 is where bank-vault robberies open up — the endgame money loop starts here (see Maximum Withdrawal).

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Just play the Chapter 2 mission of the same name; it pops on completion. No trophy depends on how a mission is played — there are no mission gold medals to chase.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 3 heist mission The Cartel Heist; the trophy pops on completion. Do not confuse it with Maximum Withdrawal, which is about open-world bank vaults — a different trophy with a different task.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play; nothing extra to do — it pops on completion.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission Headliners; the trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown; the trophy pops on completion. The airport is also the location for Catch Me If You Can — a different trophy with a different task.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory; the trophy pops on completion. This confirms the story runs into Chapter 5 — relevant to the wording note on You Gotta Know When to Get Off.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts 9 types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), playing a video/arcade game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race), and performing a stunt. Check what is left at Touchpad, Progress, Activities. Most types are introduced automatically by the story, so this pops naturally while working on other trophies — do not grind it separately.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one drone race at each of the 14 locations (42 races exist in total). The 100% checklist wants all 42 races, so finish each location fully while you are there instead of coming back. Drone-race wins also count toward the “win a race” activity type for Master of None.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: 40 different races exist; winning the same race twice does not count twice. Spread wins across race types (car races, race challenges, Top Fun drone races) — drone wins double-count toward Top Fun. Track which races are already won before repeating one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission “Feng Shui”; afterwards he texts a fishing spot (purple icon, west of Key Lento). Play through his fishing quests until the challenge against him unlocks, then beat him in it. Fishing also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Four games exist: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind (all on the TV at home) and Bang For Your Buck (arcade cabinets around Leonida). “Complete” means finishing all levels of one game once; beating every challenge inside it is not required. Home-TV games can be done as early as Chapter 1, though they are temporarily unavailable during some story sections.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline, starting in Chapter 3 when Andy calls or texts her an address in Belville. Five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass — the last one awards the trophy. Andy does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks — keep the two systems separate.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's line starts in Chapter 1 (green “KR” icon, Key Lento) after the mission “Island Dreams”; he hires you to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor, then bring it back. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later (calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 can speed this up). Track progress at Progress, Collections, Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Starts at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission “Coffee Break”. Five jobs in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes — the last one awards the trophy. Billy does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Unlocks after the Chapter 3 mission “Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS”, which also unlocks the Key Cloner; Randy then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green “RK” icon, west Vice City). Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check whether a car is on his list; cars he marks appear in fixed locations, but street cars count too. The best hunting ground is Vice Beach / Ocean Beach — sports cars park outside hotels or cruise around. Deliver in good condition for more pay. The Zorrusso from the story mission counts as the first delivery.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only questline, starting after the Chapter 3 mission “Here, Kitty Kitty”; purple markers show Synthetic Labs around Vice City. First quest is “Take Out Kitty Litter” (destroy the labs); after enough are destroyed, the second quest “Spin On This” (shut down the labs) awards the trophy. Tyrone does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Potentially missable — do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation to be safe. It is unconfirmed whether that meditation is actually required.
trophies.guide: 18 meditation spots across 10 locations; meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts twice, and the final one needs both characters together (possible after Chapter 2 “Coffee Break”). Track progress at Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. CHAPTER 1 WARNING: after the mission “Down to Earth”, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and a prompt offers “Accept”. Do it: the spot is gone after Chapter 1 and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, so this warning is trophy-specific.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason-only questline; Bret texts Jason after Chapter 2 “Coffee Break”, starting with “Veteran Hunted” in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots (purple icons); hunt the animals on his Target Decks and bring them back as Jason. Bret gives the unique hunting rifle “Killtelligence SM-69” on the first quest (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker); a clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. UNCONFIRMED: which exact animal triggers the trophy is still being confirmed — the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so it should pop during that grind.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: 80 challenges exist; the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops automatically on the way to A Long Road. Track them at Progress, Challenges (finished ones get a tick); many complete passively while chasing other trophies. Leave this for late cleanup, then pick the easiest remaining challenges — 10 can be skipped entirely.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Only possible after Chapter 2 “Coffee Break”, when Jason and Lucia can be together; call your partner with hold-Right on the D-pad + Triangle. Cause chaos until the wanted level hits 4 stars, then escape — the trophy counts once you are out of the red “heat” zone, not just out of the flashing search area. Easiest escape reported: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County) — police struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see in. It often pops on its own during bank-vault robberies, which always give 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only possible after Chapter 2 “Coffee Break” (partner free-roam); bring your partner, then hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while staying wanted (flashing red/blue) the whole time. Go in with body armour, sticky bombs and healing items; rob a couple of items per shop and ideally break the back-room safe. Good spot: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Chapter 3 “Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs”). The pop is delayed by about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop; if it does not fire, hit a fourth shop and keep going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.targetNote: 100 of 557 vehicles; the 100% checklist needs 200 base models
trophies.guide: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1); driving them is not needed — standing by a busy road and scanning passing traffic works. 557 vehicles exist at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes); the 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so this pops during that grind. Check discovered totals at Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is L3+R3 while aiming; it slows time and drains the purple focus bar (top-left, under health/stamina). Fill Focus first (eat/drink, wash up at home, or use Adrenaline to extend it) and use an assault rifle — the window only lasts a few seconds. Line up 5 enemies before activating it; gang-operation thugs work well. It reportedly does not work on soldiers, police or civilians, so do not farm it on them. Focus has 4 levels (raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots); it gets easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger jet that is docked to a departure terminal's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Easiest are gates E3/E4: drive through an airfield fence, use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge (or walk in through the terminal), go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse out and take off. Fly about 1 km away from the airport before the trophy fires; the pop is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a riddle — it never says “tank”. Steal a military tank (“Rhino”) from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County; tanks sit at the south end of the base. Enter through the gate (or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), get in a tank and shoot enemies from inside until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3 “Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs” — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently opening alarmed doors and unlocks jewelry-store robberies (green icons). Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (kicking it in sets off the alarm); find the note with the safe code in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. Good location: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. The trophy fires shortly after leaving the store.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Easiest route: do the Chapter 4 mission “That's Where The Money Is…” — tailing the armored truck to a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck, then escape the red heat zone or use a Pay 'n' Spray. Earlier method: box in a roaming armored truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and escape the heat radius (sticky bombs become available via Yasmani's shop after his quests). All 8 large bank jobs are needed for 100% anyway, so this usually pops on its own.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: “Explore” means fully unfogging the whole map — fly a plane over every dark/fogged patch until the entire map is visible. A plane is far faster than driving; work through the map region by region so no corner is missed. Exploring also reveals stunt spots, race locations and activity icons, so it feeds several other trophies.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.targetNote: 1 operation from each of 9 gangs; 39 operations in total
trophies.guide: 9 gangs run 39 illegal operations in total (yellow map icons); this trophy needs just 1 operation from each gang. Track per-gang counts at Progress, Gangs; the 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops during that grind. Operations get marked as you go near them, and many are marked automatically through story progress.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: REPORTED METHOD (PowerPyx only — not confirmed): go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini, then drink it while standing next to the bar. GTABase lists the exact steps as unconfirmed, so treat this as a reported method, not a confirmed fact. Location is Ocean Beach, Vice City — the same area as the Chapter 4 mission “Ocean Beach”, but this is a separate free-roam task.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: REPORTED METHOD (PowerPyx only — not confirmed): steal the specific blue “Banshee” from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it forward straight through the showroom window. The Key Cloner is required first (unlocked in Chapter 3 “Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS” for Randy) — the car cannot be taken before that. Only that blue Banshee counts, not any other car; the pop is slightly delayed and fires after driving away down the street. It is an easter-egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III. GTABase lists the exact steps as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by the Chapter 2 optional mission “Hit Kingpin Bowling”. Bring sticky bombs (from Ammu-Nation) for the safe. Steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch (south-east office), the unique “Gutterball Moreland 850” shotgun (north-east table), and the safe (north-east hallway). The trophy fires after escaping the police, not when the third item is picked up; killing the enemies inside is not required. If the mission visit only yields some items, wait for the robbery icon to respawn (takes a long time) and grab the rest later — it still counts.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is a riddle — it never mentions strength. Guide consensus (PowerPyx + GTABase): max out Strength for BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time; check levels at Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, select character, Strength (heart icon). Only possible after Chapter 2 “Coffee Break”, when switching between characters unlocks; buy a fitness-club membership and always train together (call your partner) — training one trains the other too. Home workouts become available after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The description is a riddle. Guide consensus (PowerPyx + GTABase): perform 500 actions that affect the Criminal Profile; the trophy itself shows the running count (x/500). Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile) so each qualifying action shows a demon-face icon. Profile tiers run Professional (stealthy, clean escapes) to Hardened to Violent to Psycho to Irredeemable; it usually pops passively during other trophies. Avoid Irredeemable — it is permanent and police shoot on sight more often. If it is the last trophy left, it can be farmed quickly, but heed the Irredeemable warning first.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED — do not trust any method presented as fact for this trophy. PowerPyx: currently unknown (believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, possibly robbing it later again in a specific manner; located in Vice City, Little Cuba). GTABase: exact steps are not confirmed yet. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something; until the community confirms a method, this guide shows it as unknown rather than inventing steps.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: REPORTED METHOD (PowerPyx only — not confirmed): a UFO easter egg on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, solo. Look for a blinking car at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods to a UFO (bright blue light in the sky); approach it, it drops an abducted woman — talk to her, offer help, then go back to her car at the roadside. GTABase lists the exact steps as unconfirmed and GTASix.how cites player videos of the same encounter — present as reported, not confirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: DISPUTED METHOD: PowerPyx says ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds, in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach. GTABase disagrees on certainty: it says the description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle, but exact steps are unconfirmed. Try the PowerPyx method first, but treat it as disputed. Do not confuse this with Let's Go Bowling — different trophy, different task, despite the bowling wordplay in both names.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3 “Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)” — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer needed to launder marked bills. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative, not in one trip. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so the robberies done for 100% usually cover this on their own.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Any spending counts across every shop type; guns, car mods and tattoos burn through the total fastest. There are 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. Spending done for other trophies (garages, registrations, gear) counts toward this automatically.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the 8 purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate phone app (unlocks after Chapter 2 “Daily Driver”); total cost is about $160,000. The 4 garages the story gives you do NOT count — only the 8 bought ones. Buying garages also creates the parking space needed for On the Spot, so do this before registering vehicles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app installs after Chapter 2 “Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses)”; it lets registered stolen vehicles be delivered to your location. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose “Respray” then “Register” in his garage; registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes. Early on he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can also be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Free garage space is required (see Little Boxes first).
